subtopics.label: Wildfire Smoke Causes Hazardous Michigan Air Quality
subtopics.attitude: Alarmed and concerned about dangerous air quality
subtopics.summary: People are discussing the dangerous and hazardous air quality in Michigan and the Great Lakes region due to thick wildfire smoke [116931496205860884, 116929701391088819, 116930486104415119]. This smoke originates from wildfires burning in Canada (Ontario) and northern Minnesota, being pulled down across the Great Lakes [116931496205860884, 116929701391088819]. Detroit, in particular, experienced "hazardous" air quality early Thursday, ranking as the worst in the world at that time [116930486104415119].

key_quotes.quote: 'Dangerous' air quality in Detroit, Minneapolis as thick wildfire smoke shrouds the sky
key_quotes.note: This quote highlights the severity of the air quality issue and its broad impact on major cities in the region.

key_quotes.quote: Air Quality flips to ‘Hazardous’ as wildfire smoke chokes Michigan
key_quotes.note: This emphasizes the sudden and severe deterioration of air quality specifically in Michigan, affecting the Great Lakes region.

key_quotes.quote: Detroit’s air quality early Thursday ranked as hazardous, worst in the world
key_quotes.note: This quote underscores the extreme and globally recognized poor air quality experienced in a major Great Lakes city.

subtopics.label: Boundary Waters Wildfires and Closures
subtopics.summary: This cluster focuses on the temporary closure of the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness by the U.S. Forest Service due to multiple wildfires burning in northeastern Minnesota [116914434615354522, 116918563000242753]. These fires, exacerbated by extreme heat and dry weather, have destroyed thousands of acres across Minnesota, Ontario, and Manitoba, with some straddling the U.S.-Canadian border [116914434615354522, 116918563000242753, 116941574720763512]. Evacuation orders have also been expanded for wildfires burning northeast of Ely [116918563000242753].

key_quotes.quote: Forest Service closing Boundary Waters amid extreme heat, wildfires
key_quotes.note: This quote directly states the main action being taken and the primary reasons for it, central to the cluster's discussion.

key_quotes.quote: Evacuation orders expanded for wildfire burning northeast of Ely
key_quotes.note: This highlights a significant impact on local communities beyond just the wilderness area itself, showing the escalating severity.

key_quotes.quote: destroyed thousands of acres in Manitoba, Ontario, and Minnesota, with many of the fires straddling the U.S.-Canadian border
key_quotes.note: This quote illustrates the large scale and cross-border nature of the wildfire issue, indicating a wider regional crisis.
